nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances in UniswapExchange; mutated unsafely in transferFrom/mint/batchSend
Public nested mapping(address=>address=>uint) of spend allowances in UniswapExchange
Private owner address used as the sole privileged access-control gate for admin functions
Constant decimals = 18 used to scale minted and configured amounts
Total token supply set in constructor
Private mapping(address=>uint) counting sales per address, used by condition()
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist toggled in _mints and read in ensure()
Private minimum sale threshold set in init()
Private maximum sale threshold set in init()
Private sale count limit set in init() and checked in condition()
Special whitelisted trade address set by setTradeAddress()
Constant Uniswap router address used in ensure() whitelist comparison
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
Internal whitelist gate that checks owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale and falls back to condition()
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance and balance mutations without SafeMath
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
Internal view sale-limit validator reading _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum
Owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary address a with arbitrary calldata b
Privileged mint that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and sets canSale, using unchecked multiplication
Owner-only initializer of sale parameters (_minSale,_maxSale,_saleNum)
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked total and balance subtraction
Owner-only setter of tradeAddress whitelist entry
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation from factory and tokens
Constructor initializing name, symbol, supply, owner, balances and router allowance
External caller address, used for access control and as from/spender identity
Low-level delegatecall executing arbitrary external code in this contract's context

allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath

edges.reason: delegate requires msg.sender == owner, gating arbitrary delegatecall execution
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded address to mint
init requires msg.sender == owner to configure sale parameters
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfer
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner to whitelist a trade address
msg.sender is used as spender identity and allowance key inside transferFrom
delegate executes delegatecall to arbitrary address a, allowing external code execution and potential reentrancy
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from,_to,_value) as a gate
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to]
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
balanceOf updates use raw -= and += without SafeMath overflow checks
allowance subtraction uses raw -= without SafeMath protection
ensure computes the Uniswap pair address via pairFor
ensure compares _from/_to against owner for whitelist bypass
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when no whitelist matches
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether limits apply
condition compares _value against _minSale
condition compares _value against _maxSale
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the minted amount
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting whitelist bypass
_mints reads decimals to scale the minted amount
_mints multiplies addedValue by 10**decimals without SafeMath
init writes _minSale scaled by decimals
init writes _maxSale scaled by decimals
init writes _saleNum sale counter limit
batchSend reads and updates balanceOf for sender and each recipient
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
constructor sets totalSupply from the supply argument
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply
constructor sets unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key

_value is a formal parameter binding directly to approve
target address a flows directly into the delegatecall operation
calldata b flows directly into the delegatecall operation
spender is a formal parameter binding directly to _mints
addedValue feeds the unchecked multiplication in _mints
saleNum is a formal parameter binding directly to init
token is a formal parameter binding directly to init
maxToken is a formal parameter binding directly to init
_tos is a formal parameter binding directly to batchSend
_value is a formal parameter binding directly to batchSend
addr is a formal parameter binding directly to setTradeAddress
total is the local value subtracted from balanceOf in batchSend
i is the loop counter local of batchSend
_to is the per-iteration recipient local of batchSend
_UNI is the pair-address local computed and compared inside ensure
